$comment: Curated model metadata that GET /models does not expose yet. Every field here is a candidate for model_spec; remove entries once the API returns them. Read by scripts/build-model-catalog.js.

familyRules.$comment: Topaz Labs' video tools upscale or repair a clip you already have, so as separate cards their renders look alike. One page lists them by what they do, in this order, and each keeps its model ID, linked with ?v=. The gallery card cycles through the tools whose before and after read at card size.
familyRules.description: Topaz Labs' tools for a video you already have: five upscalers, from faithful to creative, and five that denoise, deblur, colorize, add frames or convert to HDR.

videoInputRules.$comment: Seedance's edit models take their source clip in reference_video_urls, and /video/queue rejects a request without one. GET /models lists no video input for them.

moderationRules.$comment: Outerface sets chargesForContentModeration on Runway's video models, and only those: when Runway's filters block a request, the charge stands. GET /models doesn't expose the flag yet.

endpointRules.$comment: OpenAI documents Pro and Codex models as Responses-native. Pending API team confirmation for Venice.
endpointRules.note: Pro and Codex models are Responses-native upstream. Use /responses for typed reasoning, tool-call and message items; /chat/completions stays fully supported.

endpointRules.$comment: OpenAI recommends the Responses API for GPT-5-class reasoning models. Pending API team confirmation for Venice.
endpointRules.note: OpenAI reasoning models are designed around the Responses API: reasoning, tool calls and messages come back as typed output items. /chat/completions stays fully supported.
